name: radial-card-marquee
title: Circular Card Marquee
summary: A continuous circular card marquee that orbits cards around an adaptive path with configurable speed, direction, pause, and reduced-motion behavior.
useWhen: A continuous circular card marquee that orbits cards around an adaptive path with configurable speed, direction, pause, and reduced-motion behavior.
